name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA adapters, narrow symbol/PCB workflows and seven engineering skills.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills cover EasyEDA Pro control, schematic design, PCB layout, component libraries, manufacturing release, design review and extension development. Version-pinned typed API adapters distinguish implemented public subsets, native equivalents, blocked implementations and documented omissions. Discovery is not execution support. The exact legacy read tuple is connected-read-admitted and future mismatches fail closed; legacy general writers remain runtime-disabled. Current writers are limited to eligible unused project-local symbol metadata and schematic-container titles, with separate disposable symbol-copy and PCB-title workflows. Each requires current admission, original ownership, complete closed-database effect checks and fresh saved readback. Generic geometry, referenced-symbol propagation and library writers remain unfinished. Separate diagnostic and String-precreate workflows collect bounded source, context, compiler, producer and actor/clock observations. The diagnostic tool's worker-startup wrapper uses a third original owner to arm constructor capture before one checkpoint-bound disposable project opening, with explicit debugger-pause acceptance and exact project/branch/window association. Journaled current-assignment, UI/worker actor-clock and original-channel/publisher observations follow that same original capture. Previously observed running background workers are distinguished from the new paused project worker. Opening diagnostics retain the failed stage and first bounded attachment-event reason, and fresh native installation-lease plus facade/helper proofs avoid repeated full-image hashing during debugger pauses. This route has offline and synthetic checks, not completed connected validation. Sampled assignments, channel relations and empty queues do not establish continuous publisher ownership, native peers, contained destinations, completed startup, stable baseline or create/Save authority. Startup and opening use the existing profile and may restore tabs, migrate, replay caches or automatically persist data; they are not isolated. Ambiguous stages stay consumed. Normal closure, original root/Job termination, helper release and record settlement remain separate. No force exit, Save/Discard choice, blind retry, arbitrary code or unrestricted Save is exposed. Historical journals cannot recreate ownership. Consult the skills and exhaustive coverage inventory for exact supported subsets and remaining work.
